mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, boosting corporate profit margins and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 5.0%, S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and rising RSAFS fails to predict positive 60-day returns (negative returns in >55% of cases when both are above 3-month moving averages).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) during supply expansion cycles indicates improving capacity utilization, supporting corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of rising INDPRO (3-month growth > 0.5%), S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL annualized rate exceeding 2.0% signals inflationary pressures, triggering monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annualized rate exceeds 2.0%, S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% quarterly growth supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% quarterly.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, high consumer spending (RSAFS) correlates with positive S&P 500 returns as economic momentum peaks, over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (high RSAFS and high GDP growth), S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates strong economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and falling UNRATE fails to predict positive 5-day returns (negative returns in >55% of cases when both conditions are met).
